POPULATION CORRECTION, recorded on the closed bead so its closure is not read as more than it was.

This bead closed at '38 of 38'. THE POPULATION WAS 42. My enumerating grep required `private` immediately after the type name and could not see a generic private constructor (`case class Foo[A] private`). Four types were invisible to it: CandidateLedger, InterviewModel, NarrativeBasis, SidecarTrack.

One of them, CandidateLedger, has an OPEN Mirror door and is probed on the companion door only -- a live forge this bead's closure implicitly claimed did not exist. NarrativeBasis has no probe of any kind.

The bead stays CLOSED because the work it records genuinely happened: 38 types enumerated, all probed, two suites landed and one independently Confirmed. What it does not support is the sentence 'the population is enumerated and every member has a court'. Corrected work is bd-01M19M234SRAXWAY55HY4GQ1JN.
